"Did the kids ever get royalties from playing on one of Queen's most famous songs? Of course not."

podcast.body: Written by Brian May to be an anthem similar to "We Are The Champions," this song was released as a double A-side single from the 1977 album "News of the World." It features a distinctive "boom, boom clap" rhythm that became widely recognized and adopted. Brian May expressed pride in 2021 that the song became part of public life, stating that the greatest compliment is when people think nobody wrote it, feeling it's always existed. It became a staple at high school basketball games, encouraging stomping and hand claps on the bleachers. "Brian May said of we will rock you in 2021. The thing I'm most proud of is that it became part of public life."
